scope: Waypoint 1: implement a server-owned deterministic R8 strategic decision boundary without any Gemini call, provider dependency or runtime activation.
Produce a compact full-arena 64 by 36 ASCII battlefield with exact actor, objective and support facts, a bounded committed-voyage carrier, recent-change carrier and stable basis identity.

Prepare 8 to 12 legal complete-turn candidates including the existing deterministic fallback, exact immediate consequences, future opportunities, risks and explicit uncertainty within the six-second whole-window ceiling.
Resolve model-facing candidate IDs only through current-basis one-use server capabilities and freeze strict selected/abstention response, pending/executing/committed evidence and byte/search caps.
Verify deterministic reconstruction, paired-world projection distinctions, capability rejection, response validation and detached-projection parity with authoritative R8 execution.
Waypoint 2: add a data-only, one-call local-fake adapter with a six-second whole-window deadline, strict response validation, no retry, abort, concurrency, request-budget and circuit-breaker bounds.

Integrate the strategic boundary with the private R8 coordinator through an atomic chosen-plan and pending/executing/committed voyage record while keeping all execution authority inside the current-basis resolver.
Persist the strategy policy and at most eight strategic turns in R8 replay; reconstruct committed and final uncommitted-prefix states without a provider and reject altered or extended evidence.
Attribute player counteractions separately from system changes, preserve original continuation deadlines and accepted temporary cost, and keep deterministic fallback source attribution explicit.
Waypoint 3: integrate the exact stable gemini-3.8-flash model through direct server-only structured-output REST with low thinking, strict usage parsing and no SDK dependency.
Keep Gemini shadow proposals outside execution authority while retaining source-correct pending evidence, timing, token and frozen introductory-cost measurements for every validated provider result.

Fail external configuration closed, isolate ordinary quality runs from the provider, retain cancellation/concurrency/request-budget/circuit bounds and prevent the API key or provider endpoint from entering the client bundle.
Freeze five deterministic-baseline behavioral probes and prospective useful/valid/on-time/fallback/authority/cost thresholds before collecting real deployed shadow results.
non_goals: No Gemini SDK, API key, network call, provider adapter, prompt execution, shadow mode or live model selection in Waypoint 1.
No coordinator activation, player-visible behavior, R8 public promotion, Daily/reward/PEI change, deployment variable or external-service mutation.
No change to existing R8 physics, deterministic fallback selection, objective rules, presentation, assets or legacy runtime support.
No Sorcerers source, asset or implementation input.
No Gemini SDK, API key, network call, live model selection, environment variable, deployment mutation or provider expense in Waypoint 2.
Waypoint 3 implementation does not perform a real Gemini call, mutate Render, activate live Gemini selection, promote R8 to standard Practice/Daily or change PEI/reward behavior.

reviews.details: The boundary is isolated from runtime activation, accepts only a server-computed fallback, exposes causal summaries rather than operations and keeps provider output outside execution authority. Direct review bound fallback identity into the basis, made issued capabilities globally one-use across equivalent rebuilt boundaries, froze nested strategic inputs and preserved the contract allowance for a sparse atlas when fewer than eight distinct legal turns exist. The optimized detached projection reuses current R7 combat mechanics and applies R8 objective support/contact semantics; a complete-turn parity regression found no immediate consequence difference.

The adapter receives only a compact data brief and cannot access execution, session, replay or reward authority. Direct review kept all model-shaped output behind strict syntax, current-brief semantics and one-use capabilities; retained the selection and voyage before execution; committed only after observation; separated provider, fallback and feedback attribution; and verified no external provider dependency or secret exists. Review diagnostics found and corrected partial-tick replay ordering, final-prefix recovery extension and active-request replacement edges before the final selector.

reviews.reviewer: primary assistant direct Waypoint 3 implementation review
reviews.details: The direct REST transport sends only the bounded brief, validates one complete structured response and exact usage metadata, discards raw provider failures and never receives capabilities or execution authority. Shadow always authorizes the matched deterministic fallback while retaining the unexecuted proposal and exact source for provider-free replay. Direct review moved sanitized measurement before execution so aborted matches cannot hide incurred calls, added strict outcome/decision/usage replay invariants, kept model prose out of runtime logs, froze five fixtures and thresholds before real collection, and corrected the selector without broad visual/performance work.
